title: Build the Town Hall
description: The mayor needs a town hall — the village has no heart.

hudHints.objective: Place the town hall in the village
hudHints.instruction:
Open your terminal and tell Claude:
"use the place-town-hall skill"
hudHints.detail: Claude Code has skills — reusable recipes that do small jobs. The place-town-hall skill copies the town hall sprite (already on disk) into place so the village can see it. No image generation, no API calls.

npcReaction.speaker: Mayor Bramble
npcReaction.text: It's... it's real. I can feel the ground settling under it.

_creatorNote.lesson: Players learn to invoke skills from their terminal via Claude Code. This is Phase 1 — the quest HUD gives them the exact command. The NPC never breaks the fiction.
_creatorNote.realWorldParallel: Running a slash command or skill in Claude Code to generate project assets
